<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/data/validation.zod.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ab820016b3e9691870e24a9bbb867336ee5e8f72` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: 67/67 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e6737d70a7bcbd52f41c7077080bd557d41f0913`

### ① Derived judgments
1. **BLOCKING — the `matches` site does not parse when copied.** TSDoc (validation.zod.ts:478, in a `typescript` fence): `condition: 'record.tax_id == null || !matches(record.tax_id, "^\\d{2}-\\d{7}$")'`. Pasted into a `.ts` file the JS literal yields the runtime source `... "^\d{2}-\d{7}$"`. cel-js `lib/parser.js:495-536` (`processEscapes`) accepts only `STRING_ESCAPES` (`\\ ? " ' \` a b f n r t v`), `\u`, `\x`, octal; `d` throws `invalid_escape_sequence`. Probe via `ExpressionEngine.evaluate` (`@objectstack/formula` dist, cel-js 8.0.0): `{"tax_id":"12-3456789"}` → `ERR(parse: Invalid escape sequence: \d)`; same for null and `{}`. Method form `record.tax_id.matches("^\d...")` fails identically. This is the card's own defect class, and the PR-body transcript row claiming `ok:true/false` for this predicate cannot have been measured on the copied literal. Smallest fix: `"^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{7}$"` (no escapes, host-agnostic); probed: null → true, `12-3456789` → false, `1234` → true, `not-a-tax-id` → true. (`r"^\\d{2}-\\d{7}$"` and `"^\\\\d{2}-\\\\d{7}$"` also evaluate but are host-sensitive.) Then correct the changeset table row and the PR transcript row.
2. **BLOCKING — changeset sentences false at head.** (a) "`@marcbachmann/cel-js` parses `=` as the start of an assignment": parser.js:234-236 `case '='` requires a second `=` else falls to `Unexpected character: =` (probe: `record.a = 1` → `parse: Unexpected character: =`); cel-js has no assignment. Fix: "rejects a lone `=` as an unexpected character; CEL equality is `==`". (b) "both branches evaluate as expected for all 19" and the row `"^\d{2}-\d{7}$"` under "new (evaluates)" are false per item 1; fix after item 1.
3. **BLOCKING (consistency) — fixtures left behind under the widened scope.** validation.test.ts at head still carries verbatim docblock predicates whose surrounding name/message text is verbatim too: `:635 is_taxable = true` (then name+message = UC6), `:704/:709/:715 region = "EU"`, `gdpr_consent_given = false`, `tos_accepted = false` (otherwise block = UC4), `:727/:732 user_role = "manager"`, `approval_amount > 50000` (message = UC7), `:554/:559 country = "US"`, `state = "CA"`. The PR body's own criterion ("verbatim copy keyed to the same test name/message text") is met by these, so its acceptance note and the changeset's "fixtures that copy ... verbatim ... move with them" are inaccurate. Parse-only (`.not.toThrow()`), no false assertion. Smallest fix: rewrite those 8 plus siblings `tax_code = null` (:640) and `tax_id = null` (:564) in the docblock's CEL.
4. Other 18 predicates: all parse and evaluate with `record.` root — probe, each with a true record and a false record: UC1 `record.account_type == 'enterprise'` / `record.approval_status == null`; UC2 `record.requires_shipping == true` / `record.shipping_address == null || record.shipping_address == ''`; UC3 `record.order_total > 10000` (15000 → true, 5000 → false; double vs int OK) / `record.manager_approval_id == null` / `record.payment_method == null`; UC4 `record.region == 'EU'` / `record.gdpr_consent_given == false` / `record.tos_accepted == false`; UC5 `record.country == 'US'` / `record.state == 'CA'`; UC6 `record.is_taxable == true` / `record.tax_code == null || record.tax_code == ''`; UC7 `record.user_role == 'manager'` / `record.approval_amount > 50000`; SF `record.type == 'enterprise'` / `record.amount > 100000 && record.approval == null`. Same field, same direction, same rule as the prose (script `condition` TRUE = violation kept). Root matches the schema's own `when` describe (validation.zod.ts:546 `P\`record.type == 'enterprise'\``) and `checkConditional` binds `record: ctx.merged` (rule-validator.ts:4225-4228).
5. Null semantics: explicit `null` → `== null` true; `0` → false; a MISSING key → `runtime: No such key` (fail-closed) in the raw engine, but the validation seam materialises declared-but-absent fields to null (rule-validator.ts:3243-3249, #1871/#4649), so an omitted declared field reads as null on insert and update. `== null` is the right platform idiom. `a == null || a == ''`: `''` → true, `null` → true only via the first disjunct (`null == ''` → false), so both are needed; equals stdlib `isBlank(record.a)` for strings; correct `ISBLANK` reading.
6. `matches` spelling: function form registered `matches(dyn, dyn): bool` (stdlib.ts:361, JS `RegExp.test`, unanchored so `^...$` is right); cel-js also ships `string.matches(string)` (functions.js:356). Both accepted.
7. Salesforce side untouched (validation.zod.ts:512-517 byte-identical vs merge-base); all 19 ObjectStack-side predicates changed; `git grep` of lines 362-537 finds no remaining `=`/`AND`/`OR`/`NOT`/`REGEX` predicate.
8. TSDoc only: diff vs merge-base `4df101c3` = 3 files (+65/−30); all 46 +/- lines in validation.zod.ts begin with ` *`; zero non-comment lines. (Two-dot `origin/main..head` spans 121 files only because the branch is behind `main`; not a defect.)
9. Moved fixtures (6 exact copies + `record.manager_approval == null`) match the docblock; 72 parse-only tests assert nothing false.
10. CI at head (13:31Z): Build Core, Dogfood x4, Temporal, Type Check debt/source/consumer, Check Changeset, Queue Guard, liveness, doc links green; Test Core 1-6, Type Check workspace, Lint and Repo Gates still in progress; none failed.

### ② Semver level
`patch` + `Clause-②: no` correct: TSDoc text and parse-only fixtures, no export, accept-set or behaviour change; ADR-0087 gate judges only declared-breaking changesets (check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:51-63), so no disposition is needed; Check Changeset green. The changeset prose must still be corrected per items 1-3.

### ③ Boundary flags
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/index.mdx:186` — verified at head still `account_type = 'Enterprise' AND contract_value = null`; recorded at docs/audits/2026-06-handwritten-docs-accuracy-followups.md:347; out of scope, agreed.
- Nested-conditional test note — inaccurate as stated: UC5 `when`s are verbatim, and UC4/UC6/UC7 fixtures (not mentioned) match name/message verbatim; see item 3.

## Contract review

Served-tier: 140/140 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b7abe173cf44a53aaffe3427171ea47715066d86`

### ① Derived judgments
1. All 19 predicates parse and evaluate as a reader gets them. Probe: each `when:`/`condition:` literal extracted byte-for-byte from head `validation.zod.ts:378-532`, JS-unescaped via `eval`, evaluated in cel-js 8.0.0 (lockfile pin) with the engine's `CEL_ENV_OPTIONS` (cel-engine.ts:49-53) and the stdlib binding `matches(dyn, dyn): bool` = `new RegExp(re).test(s)` (stdlib.ts:361), scope `{record}` as `buildScope` mounts it (stdlib.ts:438). Output `literals=19 bad=0`: every runtime string equals its comment text (no escapes remain); true-record → `true`, false-record → `false` for all 19. `matches` site: `{tax_id:null}` → true, `12-3456789` → false, `1234` / `not-a-tax-id` / `''` / `12-34567890` → true. Old literal `"^\\d{2}-\\d{7}$"` → runtime `\d` → `Invalid escape sequence: \d` (parser.js:536; `STRING_ESCAPES` :72 has no `d`). Meaning vs prose: `when` TRUE selects `then` with `record: ctx.merged` (rule-validator.ts:4225-4240); script/cross_field `condition` TRUE = `rule_violation` (checkPredicate, :4026+53); omitted declared fields are materialised to `null` (declared-fields.ts:193-203), so `== null` reads an absent field. All 19 keep the original field and direction. Non-blocking: `gdpr_consent_given == false` / `tos_accepted == false` do not fire on `null` (`null == false` → false); inherited from the original `= false`, not introduced here.
2. Changeset: every technical sentence TRUE at head. Probe: `record.a = 1` → `Unexpected character: =` (parser.js:234-236 requires a second `=`; no assignment exists); the word form `... AND record.b == null` → `Unexpected character: 'D'`; the bare `order_total` predicate → `Unknown variable: order_total`. Base census (origin/main docblock grep): 17 lone-`=` / 2 bare-field, matching "17 of the 19 / other 2". "Both branches evaluate as expected for all 19" TRUE per item 1. Dist sentence TRUE: rebuilt `@objectstack/spec` at head from a scratch archive; `dist/object.zod-gMUjcm3R.d.ts` holds each of the 19 new strings exactly once and each of 18 old spellings (both `\d` variants, `REGEX(`, bare `when: 'order_total ...'`) zero times. One wording overstatement, non-blocking: "surrounding test name and message text are verbatim copies" — `nested_validation` (`state_validation` / "State-specific validation", `ca_tax` / "California requires tax ID") and `gdpr_consent` ("GDPR consent required for EU customers") are near-copies; the predicates themselves were verbatim.
3. Fixtures: 17 strings moved; all match the docblock CEL (`order_value_validation` keeps `record.manager_approval`, one spelling off `_id`, disclosed, never verbatim). Remaining `=`/`AND`/`IN` fixtures in the `ConditionalValidationSchema` describe (test.ts:531,536,542,577,582,652,657,669,674,687,692,744) copy no docblock predicate: none left behind. Every assertion is `ValidationRuleSchema.parse(...)` `.not.toThrow()` / `.toThrow()`; none evaluates CEL; nothing false.
4. TSDoc only: 3-dot diff vs `origin/main` = 3 files (+75/−40); `validation.zod.ts` with `*`-lines stripped is byte-identical main vs head (`diff` empty). Salesforce block (:512-521) untouched; head docblock grep finds no `=` / `AND` / `OR` / `NOT(` / `REGEX(` predicate; 19/19 converted.
5. PR body transcript: its 19 runtime strings equal the probe's; it evaluates the copied literals, and states the old `matches` row "were not measured on the copied literal", reproducing `Invalid escape sequence: \d` on the old literal.
6. CI at 14:51Z: 35 success, 5 skipped, 1 in progress (Test Core 5/6); Build Core, Test Core 1-4 and 6, Type Check ×4, Lint & Repo Gates, Check Changeset ×2, Dogfood ×4, Temporal green; none failed. Head unchanged at review time.

### ② Semver level
`patch` + `Clause-②: no` correct. `readClause2Line` (clause2-line.mjs:418) run on PR body and changeset → `{"kind":"declared","value":"no","arm":null}` for both. ADR-0087 gate (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:629-640`) signals only on a `major` bump, a `**BREAKING` marker, or a `narrowing` arm; none present, so no disposition is needed. No export, accept-set or behaviour change (item 4); Check Changeset green ×2.

### ③ Boundary flags
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/index.mdx:186` still `account_type = 'Enterprise' AND contract_value = null` at head; recorded at `docs/audits/2026-06-handwritten-docs-accuracy-followups.md:347`; out of scope, agreed.
- Same file, other docblocks: `validation.zod.ts:240` (`MONTH(close_date) ... AND YEAR(close_date) ...`) and `:274` (`products = null AND stage = "closed_won"`) carry the same non-CEL spelling; outside the one docblock this card scoped; not mentioned in the PR body; needs its own card, not this PR.
- Triage 要点 2 ("best add a test that really evaluates these examples"): not done, fixtures stay parse-only; phrased as preferable, not required; noting only.
- Non-docblock `=` / `AND` / `IN` fixtures in the same describe (item 3) remain; consistent with the PR's own stated criterion.
